scripts.build: bun run build:rust && bun run --cwd apps/server build:native && bun run build:workspace
scripts.format: prettier --write .github apps compatibility design CONTRIBUTING.md README.md eslint.config.js package.json playwright.config.ts tsconfig.json vitest.config.ts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check .github apps compatibility design CONTRIBUTING.md README.md eslint.config.js package.json playwright.config.ts tsconfig.json vitest.config.ts
scripts.test:browser:rust: bun run build:rust && bun run --cwd apps/web build && SLIPSTREAM_BROWSER_SERVER=rust playwright test
scripts.test:browser: bun run build:workspace && bun run test:browser:typescript && bun run test:browser:rust
scripts.test:rust: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace --locked
scripts.test:fast: bun run test:rust && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/server build:native:test && bun run test && bun run test:browser
scripts.verify: bun run format:check && bun run test:fast && bun run build
